fixture_setup.description: A new temporary folder containing only sample.md was registered through the local Core project API. All following UI operations used the real Desktop window. User documents and credentials were not modified.

steps: Open 定时任务 > 创建任务, choose project and Agent, type @
Choose 钉钉 and confirm a branded structured token appears
Cancel without creating a scheduled task
After the user authorizes Feishu, open a new Agent task draft in the existing isolated project
Type @ and confirm 飞书 in 内置; click 飞书 and verify the branded token
Cancel the draft; the existing scheduled task list remains unchanged
checks.observed: DingTalk and, after the user completed authorization, Feishu both appear in the 内置 section. Clicking Feishu inserts its branded structured token. The existing Desktop process was used without restarting or reloading; the temporary task draft was cancelled without saving.
checks.automation: Both ready entries, Feishu disconnect/reconnect, exact Skill identity and saved payload are covered by ScheduledTasksView.behavior.test.tsx.
checks.previous_observation: The connected DingTalk entry appears in the same 内置 section. Feishu UI reports installed but currently unauthorized, so it is correctly hidden.

feishu_live_verification.scope: Post-authorization menu discovery and token insertion in real macOS Desktop. Authorization completed before opening the editor; disconnect/reconnect while the editor is already open remains covered by automated tests.

limits: The author website returned web_fetch_network_failed and was excluded; the official httpbin homepage succeeded instead.
This is a macOS development Desktop acceptance. Windows/Linux and packaged release were not exercised.
Foreground concurrent navigation is covered separately by browser-concurrent-navigation; it reuses one visible page and may overwrite another navigation.
The two public JSONPlaceholder requests were rejected with web_fetch_blocked_target; successful public JSON fetching was not established in this run.
The root provider later hit a stream idle timeout.
JSON success, Unicode, receipt/digest, byte limits and binary rejection passed isolated Go tests.
Same-batch browser request deduplication passed reducer and real-hook composition tests; concurrent live browser navigation was not separately exercised.

checks.root_cause: WebFetch previously forced direct networking, rejecting the local proxy synthetic DNS range 198.18.0.0/15 before connecting. It now selects the host network route per request and redirect; synthetic DNS is allowed only through an explicitly host-selected proxy, never as a literal target or on a direct route.
checks.proxy_trust_boundary: For synthetic DNS only, the host-configured proxy resolves and forwards the original hostname. Awaken does not claim to validate the proxy-side final IP. Ordinary public DNS is pinned even through the proxy, and private DNS/literal targets/redirects are rejected.

additional_live_transport_checks.note: A follow-up temporary diagnostic exercised the production WebFetch transport and decoder after earlier transient EOF failures. These are transport checks, not additional Desktop runs.

limits: No multi-hour endurance test was run.
Windows and Linux Desktop were not exercised.

checks.scope: One shared foreground browser tab under overlapping navigation from two general subagents; not independent page sessions.
steps: Create a fresh task in the isolated UI verification project using the default model
Ask two general subagents to navigate A1-A3 and B1-B3 concurrently without WebFetch or other browser mechanisms
Observe the single browser tab and its HTML page while navigation calls overlap
checks.initial_dispatch: The default model explicitly selected shared_readonly for the first two general agents. Six calls were rejected before transport with read_only_violation. The parent then independently spawned two new general agents using shared; host permission settings and model selection were not changed.
limits: B1 overlapped A2; B1 returned the current A2 address with status succeeded. Tab reuse works, but shared-page concurrent navigation does not provide per-agent URL isolation or request-target consistency.
A successful browser tool receipt is recorded separately from observed rendered content. The final B3 HTML page was visible in the real Desktop.
macOS development Desktop only; no packaged or other-platform test.
checks.root_completion_note: All six actual navigation calls and both shared-mode children finished before the root summary entered repeated default-provider network recovery. The test runner stopped only that remaining summary through Desktop; no fallback model was selected. This is not evidence of a normally completed root run.
